description: Insert text at a specific location in a Google Doc. Use document_get to find the appropriate index. Index 1 is the beginning of the document body.

documentId.description: The ID of the document to insert into

index.description: The zero-based index where to insert the text. Index 1 is the beginning of the document body (index 0 is reserved).

segmentId.description: The ID of the header, footer, or footnote to insert into. Leave empty for the main body.

name: document_insert
title: Insert into document
